tools.name: get_api_endpoint_schema
tools.description: Get the schema for an endpoint in the Telnyx TypeScript API. You can use the schema returned by this tool to invoke an endpoint with the `invoke_api_endpoint` tool.

endpoint.description: The name of the endpoint to get the schema for.

tools.name: list_api_endpoints
tools.description: List or search for all endpoints in the Telnyx TypeScript API

search_query.description: An optional search query to filter the endpoints by. Provide a partial name, resource, operation, or tag to filter the endpoints returned.

tools.name: invoke_api_endpoint
tools.description: Invoke an endpoint in the Telnyx TypeScript API. Note: use the `list_api_endpoints` tool to get the list of endpoints and `get_api_endpoint_schema` tool to get the schema for an endpoint.

endpoint_name.description: The name of the endpoint to invoke.

args.description: The arguments to pass to the endpoint. This must match the schema returned by the `get_api_endpoint_schema` tool.

tools.name: open_number_intelligence
tools.description: Open the Telnyx Number Intelligence MCP App for phone number lookup, validation, and enrichment workflows.

action.description: Optional no-op app opener action; omit to open the app.

tools.name: open_usage_cost_explorer
tools.description: Open the Telnyx Usage & Cost Explorer MCP App for usage and cost analysis.

action.description: Optional no-op app opener action; omit to open the app.

tools.name: open_voice_monitor
tools.description: Open the Telnyx Voice Monitor MCP App for observing and troubleshooting voice traffic.

action.description: Optional no-op app opener action; omit to open the app.
